title: LLM-Auction: Generative Auction towards LLM-Native Advertising
abstract: arXiv:2512.10551v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The commercialization of LLM applications is the next frontier in online advertising, with LLM-native advertising emerging as a promising paradigm by integrating ads into LLM-generated content. However, classic mechanisms are no longer applicable in this setting where the auction object is shifted from discrete ad slots to distributions over LLM outputs, and existing methods are impractical in industrial scenarios due to ignored externalities or high inference costs. To address these issues, we propose LLM-Auction, the first learning-based generative auction mechanism that integrates auction and generation. By formulating the allocation as preference alignment between LLM outputs and a mechanism objective that balances advertisers' value and user experience, we optimize the LLMs to inherently model allocation externalities without extra inference cost. translated_title: LLM-Auction：面向大语言模型原生广告的生成式拍卖机制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）应用的商业化是在线广告的下一个前沿领域，LLM原生广告作为一种极具前景的新范式应运而生，它通过将广告整合到LLM生成的内容中实现商业化。然而，在这种拍卖对象从离散广告位转变为LLM输出分布的新场景下，经典拍卖机制已不再适用；同时，现有方法由于忽略了外部性或推理成本过高，在工业场景中难以实用。为解决这些问题，我们提出了LLM-Auction，这是首个将拍卖与生成相融合的基于学习的生成式拍卖机制。通过将广告分配问题构建为LLM输出与机制目标（该目标平衡广告主价值与用户体验）之间的偏好对齐，我们对LLM进行优化，使其能够内在地建模分配外部性，且无需额外的推理成本。在理论层面，我们刻画了该机制的分配单调性与连续性（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个将拍卖与生成相融合的学习式生成式拍卖机制LLM-Auction，通过把广告分配构建为LLM输出与平衡广告主价值和用户体验的机制目标之间的偏好对齐，使LLM无需额外推理成本即可内在建模分配外部性，解决了传统机制在LLM原生广告场景中失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLM-Auction, the first learning-based generative auction mechanism that integrates auction and generation by formulating ad allocation as preference alignment between LLM outputs and a mechanism objective balancing advertiser value and user experience, enabling LLMs to inherently model allocation externalities without extra inference cost.
